about_the_game:
This DLC turns The Mountain and The Moron into a rogue like! With randomly made stages and items to help you reach the top of the mountain where you lost your phone from last time!

Retrieve your phone!

Go on a randomly generated adventure to find your phone! Using map chunks, the map is different every time you play, making the adventure new and unique, with the same polish of a hand crafted map!

Collect powerful items!

Items will spawn around the map, making your run more and more powerful as you loot your way to victory! Each item is unique and helps you in a different way, creating more dynamic gameplay

Don't Fall!

This DLC maintains the difficulty of the main game, forcing you to play well, or die trying!

Persistent Mechanics!

This mod shares the mechanics of the main game, allowing you to play with your favorite modifiers from the normal game, allowing for some fun combinations, and easier/harder runs!
